tei:div.tei:p: May Thy Name be praised for ever, O our King, God the great and holy King in heaven and on earth. For Thine, O Lord our God and God of our fathers, are song and glory, praise and music, might and dominion, victory, greatness and strength, fame and splendour, blessings and thanks from now until eternity. Blessed art Thou, O Lord God, King famed in eulogies, God of thanksgiving, Master of wonders, who chooses songs of praise, O King, everlasting God.
